fullText.simplified:
一、数字人舒望

    5、4、3、2、1，上传完成。

    数据库：舒多多小姐，请问您想什么时候激活数据？
    舒多多：现在就激活。
    数据库：好的，现在为您激活数据。第110982819号数字人舒望被激活。

    我叫舒望，是一名数字人。今天是2128年7月15日，是我被激活的第一天。我在成为数字人以前是一名医生，在北京医学院工作，那是中国北方最重要的医学院。因为工作太忙，我34岁才结婚。我的妻子是名音乐老师，名字叫常乐，我一直叫她阿乐。阿乐的爸爸因病来医院做手术，我是那次手术的医生，所以认识了阿乐。认识的第二年我们就结婚了，第三年我们有了女儿舒多多。小时候的多多聪明可爱，但身体不太好，经常生病。因为我的工作真的太忙，所以照顾多多的事都留给了阿乐，那段时间阿乐真的很累。
    多多生病的时候，很多人都要我们为多多的数字人做准备。早在五十多年前，人类就已经完成了数字生命的最后工作。每个人只需把记忆上传到网络里的数据库，就可以成为数字人，在网络中永生。很多快要去世的人都选择了上传记忆成为数字人。数字人有人的全部记忆，可以和家人像在世时一样聊天。
    我明白大家是为了我们好，他们觉得如果多多不在了，她还能做我们的数字人女儿。我和阿乐不愿意做这样的事，我们觉得数字生命虽然有记忆，但不是真正的“人”，那个有多多记忆的数字人不能成为我们的女儿。让人高兴的是，十岁以后，多多的身体终于好了起来。她很少再生病，我和阿乐觉得世界都变好了。
    我们一家人幸福地过了十七年。这十七年里，多多读完了大学。因为阿乐，多多也喜欢音乐，她也成为了一名音乐老师。阿乐在多多上大学的时候，去学了跳舞。她跳得太好了，是跳舞班里跳得最好的学生。我除了工作越来越忙，其他都是老样子。
fullText.traditional:
一、數字人舒望

    5、4、3、2、1，上傳完成。

    數據庫：舒多多小姐，請問您想什麼時候激活數據？
    舒多多：現在就激活。
    數據庫：好的，現在為您激活數據。第110982819號數字人舒望被激活。

    我叫舒望，是一名數字人。今天是2128年7月15日，是我被激活的第一天。我在成為數字人以前是一名醫生，在北京醫學院工作，那是中國北方最重要的醫學院。因為工作太忙，我34歲才結婚。我的妻子是名音樂老師，名字叫常樂，我一直叫她阿樂。阿樂的爸爸因病來醫院做手術，我是那次手術的醫生，所以認識了阿樂。認識的第二年我們就結婚了，第三年我們有了女兒舒多多。小時候的多多聰明可愛，但身體不太好，經常生病。因為我的工作真的太忙，所以照顧多多的事都留給了阿樂，那段時間阿樂真的很累。
    多多生病的時候，很多人都要我們為多多的數字人做準備。早在五十多年前，人類就已經完成了數字生命的最後工作。每個人只需把記憶上傳到網絡裡的數據庫，就可以成為數字人，在網絡中永生。很多快要去世的人都選擇了上傳記憶成為數字人。數字人有人的全部記憶，可以和家人像在世時一樣聊天。
    我明白大家是為了我們好，他們覺得如果多多不在了，她還能做我們的數字人女兒。我和阿樂不願意做這樣的事，我們覺得數字生命雖然有記憶，但不是真正的“人”，那個有多多記憶的數字人不能成為我們的女兒。讓人高興的是，十歲以後，多多的身體終於好了起來。她很少再生病，我和阿樂覺得世界都變好了。
    我們一家人幸福地過了十七年。這十七年裡，多多讀完了大學。因為阿樂，多多也喜歡音樂，她也成為了一名音樂老師。阿樂在多多上大學的時候，去學了跳舞。她跳得太好了，是跳舞班裡跳得最好的學生。我除了工作越來越忙，其他都是老樣子。

sentences.simplified: 数据库：舒多多小姐，请问您想什么时候激活数据？
sentences.traditional: 數據庫：舒多多小姐，請問您想什麼時候激活數據？
sentences.pinyin: shù jù kù shū duō duō xiǎo jiě qǐng wèn nín xiǎng shén me shí hou jī huó shù jù
sentences.english: Database: Miss Shu Duoduo, when would you like to activate the data?

sentences.simplified: 舒多多：现在就激活。
sentences.traditional: 舒多多：現在就激活。
sentences.pinyin: shū duō duō xiàn zài jiù jī huó
sentences.english: Shu Duoduo: Activate it now.

sentences.simplified: 数据库：好的，现在为您激活数据。
sentences.traditional: 數據庫：好的，現在為您激活數據。
sentences.pinyin: shù jù kù hǎo de xiàn zài wèi nín jī huó shù jù
sentences.english: Database: OK, the data will be activated for you now.

sentences.simplified: 第110982819号数字人舒望被激活。
sentences.traditional: 第110982819號數字人舒望被激活。
sentences.pinyin: dì 9 hào shù zì rén shū wàng bèi jī huó
sentences.english: Digital human number 110982819 Shu Wang has been activated.

sentences.simplified: 我叫舒望，是一名数字人。今天是2128年7月15日，是我被激活的第一天。
sentences.traditional: 我叫舒望，是一名數字人。今天是2128年7月15日，是我被激活的第一天。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiào shū wàng shì yì míng shù zì rén jīn tiān shì 4 nián qī yuè 2 rì shì wǒ bèi jī huó de dì yī tiān
sentences.english: My name is Shu Wang. I am a digital human. Today is July 15th, 2128, the first day I was activated.

sentences.simplified: 我在成为数字人以前是一名医生，
sentences.traditional: 我在成為數字人以前是一名醫生，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài chéng wéi shù zì rén yǐ qián shì yì míng yī shēng
sentences.english: Before I became a digital human, I was a doctor.

sentences.simplified: 在北京医学院工作，那是中国北方最重要的医学院。
sentences.traditional: 在北京醫學院工作，那是中國北方最重要的醫學院。
sentences.pinyin: zài běi jīng yī xué yuàn gōng zuò nà shì zhōng guó běi fāng zuì zhòng yào de yī xué yuàn
sentences.english: I worked at Beijing Medical School, which is the most important medical school in northern China.

sentences.simplified: 因为工作太忙，我34岁才结婚。
sentences.traditional: 因為工作太忙，我34歲才結婚。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi gōng zuò tài máng wǒ 3 suì cái jié hūn
sentences.english: Because I was too busy with work, I didn’t get married until I was 34.

sentences.simplified: 我的妻子是名音乐老师，名字叫常乐，我一直叫她阿乐。
sentences.traditional: 我的妻子是名音樂老師，名字叫常樂，我一直叫她阿樂。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de qī zi shì míng yīn yuè lǎo shī míng zi jiào cháng yuè wǒ yì zhí jiào tā ā yuè
sentences.english: My wife was a music teacher. Her name was Chang Yue. I always called her Ah Yue.

sentences.simplified: 阿乐的爸爸因病来医院做手术，我是那次手术的医生，所以认识了阿乐。
sentences.traditional: 阿樂的爸爸因病來醫院做手術，我是那次手術的醫生，所以認識了阿樂。
sentences.pinyin: ā yuè de bà ba yīn bìng lái yī yuàn zuò shǒu shù wǒ shì nà cì shǒu shù de yī shēng suǒ yǐ rèn shi le ā yuè
sentences.english: Ah Yue’s father came to the hospital for surgery due to illness. I was the doctor in that surgery, so I got to know Ah Yue.

sentences.simplified: 认识的第二年我们就结婚了，第三年我们有了女儿舒多多。
sentences.traditional: 認識的第二年我們就結婚了，第三年我們有了女兒舒多多。
sentences.pinyin: rèn shi de dì èr nián wǒ men jiù jié hūn le dì sān nián wǒ men yǒu le nǚ ér shū duō duō
sentences.english: We got married in the second year of knowing each other, and in the third year, we had our daughter, Shu Duoduo.

sentences.simplified: 小时候的多多聪明可爱，但身体不太好，经常生病。
sentences.traditional: 小時候的多多聰明可愛，但身體不太好，經常生病。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo shí hou de duō duō cōng ming kě ài dàn shēn tǐ bú tài hǎo jīng cháng shēng bìng
sentences.english: When she was little, Duoduo was smart and adorable, but her health wasn’t very good, and she often got sick.

sentences.simplified: 因为我的工作真的太忙，所以照顾多多的事都留给了阿乐，那段时间阿乐真的很累。
sentences.traditional: 因為我的工作真的太忙，所以照顧多多的事都留給了阿樂，那段時間阿樂真的很累。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ de gōng zuò zhēn de tài máng suǒ yǐ zhào gù duō duō de shì dōu liú gěi le ā yuè nà duàn shí jiān ā yuè zhēn de hěn lèi
sentences.english: Because I was really too busy with work, looking after Duoduo was left to Ah Yue. Ah Yue was really tired during that time.

sentences.simplified: 多多生病的时候，很多人都要我们为多多的数字人做准备。
sentences.traditional: 多多生病的時候，很多人都要我們為多多的數字人做準備。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō shēng bìng de shí hou hěn duō rén dōu yào wǒ men wèi duō duō de shù zì rén zuò zhǔn bèi
sentences.english: When Duoduo was sick, many people urged us to make preparations for a digital human for Duoduo.

sentences.simplified: 早在五十多年前，人类就已经完成了数字生命的最后工作。
sentences.traditional: 早在五十多年前，人類就已經完成了數字生命的最後工作。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo zài wǔ shí duō nián qián rén lèi jiù yǐ jīng wán chéng le shù zì shēng mìng de zuì hòu gōng zuò
sentences.english: More than fifty years ago, humanity completed the final work required for digital life.

sentences.simplified: 每个人只需把记忆上传到网络里的数据库，
sentences.traditional: 每個人只需把記憶上傳到網絡裡的數據庫，
sentences.pinyin: měi ge rén zhǐ xū bǎ jì yì shàng chuán dào wǎng luò lǐ de shù jù kù
sentences.english: Each person just needs to upload their memories to the database on the network.

sentences.simplified: 就可以成为数字人，在网络中永生。
sentences.traditional: 就可以成為數字人，在網絡中永生。
sentences.pinyin: jiù kě yǐ chéng wéi shù zì rén zài wǎng luò zhōng yǒng shēng
sentences.english: Then they can become a digital human, and live forever on the network.

sentences.simplified: 很多快要去世的人都选择了上传记忆成为数字人。
sentences.traditional: 很多快要去世的人都選擇了上傳記憶成為數字人。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō kuài yào qù shì de rén dōu xuǎn zé le shàng chuán jì yì chéng wéi shù zì rén
sentences.english: Many people who are about to die choose to upload their memories to become digital humans.

sentences.simplified: 数字人有人的全部记忆，可以和家人像在世时一样聊天。
sentences.traditional: 數字人有人的全部記憶，可以和家人像在世時一樣聊天。
sentences.pinyin: shù zì rén yǒu rén de quán bù jì yì kě yǐ hé jiā rén xiàng zài shì shí yí yàng liáo tiān
sentences.english: Digital humans have all of their human memories and can chat with their families just as they did when they were alive.

sentences.simplified: 我明白大家是为了我们好，他们觉得如果多多不在了，她还能做我们的数字人女儿。
sentences.traditional: 我明白大家是為了我們好，他們覺得如果多多不在了，她還能做我們的數字人女兒。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ míng bai dà jiā shì wèi le wǒ men hǎo tā men jué de rú guǒ duō duō bú zài le tā hái néng zuò wǒ men de shù zì rén nǚ ér
sentences.english: I knew that everyone meant well. They felt that if Duoduo passed away, she could still be our digital daughter.

sentences.simplified: 我和阿乐不愿意做这样的事，我们觉得数字生命虽然有记忆，但不是真正的“人”，
sentences.traditional: 我和阿樂不願意做這樣的事，我們覺得數字生命雖然有記憶，但不是真正的“人”，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hé ā yuè bú yuàn yì zuò zhè yàng de shì wǒ men jué de shù zì shēng mìng suī rán yǒu jì yì dàn bú shì zhēn zhèng de rén
sentences.english: Ah Yue and I were not willing to do this. We feel that although a digital life has memories, it is not a real “person”.

sentences.simplified: 那个有多多记忆的数字人不能成为我们的女儿。
sentences.traditional: 那個有多多記憶的數字人不能成為我們的女兒。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge yǒu duō duō jì yì de shù zì rén bù néng chéng wéi wǒ men de nǚ ér
sentences.english: That digital human with Duoduo’s memories could not become our daughter.

sentences.simplified: 让人高兴的是，十岁以后，多多的身体终于好了起来。
sentences.traditional: 讓人高興的是，十歲以後，多多的身體終於好了起來。
sentences.pinyin: ràng rén gāo xìng de shì shí suì yǐ hòu duō duō de shēn tǐ zhōng yú hǎo le qǐ lái
sentences.english: The good news is that after the age of ten, Duoduo’s health finally improved.

sentences.simplified: 她很少再生病，我和阿乐觉得世界都变好了。
sentences.traditional: 她很少再生病，我和阿樂覺得世界都變好了。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn shǎo zài shēng bìng wǒ hé ā yuè jué de shì jiè dōu biàn hǎo le
sentences.english: She rarely got sick anymore. Ah Yue and I felt like the world had become a better place.

sentences.simplified: 我们一家人幸福地过了十七年。这十七年里，多多读完了大学。
sentences.traditional: 我們一家人幸福地過了十七年。這十七年裡，多多讀完了大學。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men yì jiā rén xìng fú de guò le shí qī nián zhè shí qī nián lǐ duō duō dú wán le dà xué
sentences.english: Our family lived happily for seventeen years. During these seventeen years, Duoduo completed college.

sentences.simplified: 因为阿乐，多多也喜欢音乐，她也成为了一名音乐老师。
sentences.traditional: 因為阿樂，多多也喜歡音樂，她也成為了一名音樂老師。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi ā yuè duō duō yě xǐ huan yīn yuè tā yě chéng wéi le yì míng yīn yuè lǎo shī
sentences.english: Because of Ah Yue, Duoduo also liked music. She also became a music teacher.

sentences.simplified: 阿乐在多多上大学的时候，去学了跳舞。
sentences.traditional: 阿樂在多多上大學的時候，去學了跳舞。
sentences.pinyin: ā yuè zài duō duō shàng dà xué de shí hou qù xué le tiào wǔ
sentences.english: When Duoduo was in college, Ah Yue went to learn dancing.

sentences.simplified: 她跳得太好了，是跳舞班里跳得最好的学生。
sentences.traditional: 她跳得太好了，是跳舞班裡跳得最好的學生。
sentences.pinyin: tā tiào de tài hǎo le shì tiào wǔ bān lǐ tiào de zuì hǎo de xué sheng
sentences.english: She danced so well that she was the best student in the dance class.

sentences.simplified: 我除了工作越来越忙，其他都是老样子。
sentences.traditional: 我除了工作越來越忙，其他都是老樣子。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ chú le gōng zuò yuè lái yuè máng qí tā dōu shì lǎo yàng zi
sentences.english: Apart from work getting busier and busier, everything else remained the same.

sentence_translations: (1) Digital Human Shu Wang
5, 4, 3, 2, 1, upload complete.
Database: Miss Shu Duoduo, when would you like to activate the data?
Shu Duoduo: Activate it now.
Database: OK, the data will be activated for you now.
Digital human number 110982819 Shu Wang has been activated.
My name is Shu Wang. I am a digital human. Today is July 15th, 2128, the first day I was activated.
Before I became a digital human, I was a doctor.
I worked at Beijing Medical School, which is the most important medical school in northern China.
Because I was too busy with work, I didn’t get married until I was 34.
My wife was a music teacher. Her name was Chang Yue. I always called her Ah Yue.
Ah Yue’s father came to the hospital for surgery due to illness. I was the doctor in that surgery, so I got to know Ah Yue.
We got married in the second year of knowing each other, and in the third year, we had our daughter, Shu Duoduo.
When she was little, Duoduo was smart and adorable, but her health wasn’t very good, and she often got sick.
Because I was really too busy with work, looking after Duoduo was left to Ah Yue. Ah Yue was really tired during that time.
When Duoduo was sick, many people urged us to make preparations for a digital human for Duoduo.
More than fifty years ago, humanity completed the final work required for digital life.
Each person just needs to upload their memories to the database on the network.
Then they can become a digital human, and live forever on the network.
Many people who are about to die choose to upload their memories to become digital humans.
Digital humans have all of their human memories and can chat with their families just as they did when they were alive.
I knew that everyone meant well. They felt that if Duoduo passed away, she could still be our digital daughter.
Ah Yue and I were not willing to do this. We feel that although a digital life has memories, it is not a real “person”.
That digital human with Duoduo’s memories could not become our daughter.
The good news is that after the age of ten, Duoduo’s health finally improved.
She rarely got sick anymore. Ah Yue and I felt like the world had become a better place.
Our family lived happily for seventeen years. During these seventeen years, Duoduo completed college.
Because of Ah Yue, Duoduo also liked music. She also became a music teacher.
When Duoduo was in college, Ah Yue went to learn dancing.
She danced so well that she was the best student in the dance class.
Apart from work getting busier and busier, everything else remained the same.
